title: vaultExecutorHost
responsibility: Decides whether a host may run automated Credential Vault browser logins.

inputs.name: vaultExecutorHost.probe
inputs.description: Preflight facts about the host: isolation kind, shared-sudo flag, the agent user groups, sudo, Docker socket and executor home access, the executor user and the Chromium sandbox result.

outputs.name: vaultExecutorHost
outputs.description: Eligible with its isolation kind, or ineligible with every reason found.
